spec.claim_summary: Bitcoin dropping below its 200-week moving average is presented as an automatic buying opportunity.

claimed.other: Investing $10,000 during the March 2020 dip would have resulted in a 1.8 BTC / $105,000 portfolio today

assumptions: Timeframe is 1d from the page chart; the rule is evaluated on daily closes.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: true 200-week moving average on 200 weekly closes cannot be expressed - timeframe is limited to 1h/4h/1d and indicators are computed on that timeframe, so entry uses a 1400-bar daily SMA as a length-equivalent approximation with different signal timing.
Entry uses SMA as the most common reading because average type is not stated.
No exit is stated; the illustration holds from March 2020 to today, so no reclaim exit is used.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: indefinite buy-and-hold with no exit cannot be expressed - the spec requires an exit, so a very long max_hold_bars is used as the closest testable core to emulate holding to the end of available history.

evidence.quote: price falls below its 200-week moving average
Investing $10,000 during the March 2020 dip would have resulted in a 1.8 BTC / $105,000 portfolio today
